title: Private/VPC Quarterly Roadmap — Activation Velocity & Cross-team Contracting
creator: Maya Chen
description:
Goal: Define and operationalize the quarterly roadmap for Private/VPC/On‑Prem features focused on increasing activation velocity for enterprise tenants while bounding platform risk and capacity. Deliverables: a sequenced initiative backlog, OKR-aligned milestones, compatibility sandbox plan, cross-team contracting template (SLA/rollforward), and a sprint buffer policy for isolated tenancy onboarding. Scope explicitly excludes data plane implementation work (owned by Eng), but includes gating acceptance criteria and rollout orchestration patterns.

Context and motivation: Several enterprise prospects have slowed closing due to long activation windows. Sales and CS require predictable onboarding timelines and compatibility guarantees. Engineering capacity is constrained for Q2; we must trade time-to-market against risk and operational burden. This ticket coordinates PM work to translate OKRs into a prioritized roadmap and clear acceptance gates for partner teams.
comments: 2026-03-02  Initial draft of sequencing shared with Eng leads (Slack thread #private-roadmap). Action: Eng to provide capacity signal by 2026-03-06.

2026-03-05  Eng capacity estimate received: baseline 3 sprint equivalents for compatibility tooling (ENG-1842). Reprioritized: split 'compatibility sandbox' into 'core checks' and 'integration adapters'.
2026-03-07  Legal reviewed cross-team contracting template (Confluence doc) and requested KMS/HSM language; added to acceptance criteria.
2026-03-09  Design provided initial console mockups for onboarding flow (Drive: /designs/private-onboard/v1). Feedback: reduce friction on network configuration step; add 'checklist' for tenants.
2026-03-10  Alignment session with Sales, CS, Eng, Security. Decision to run a two-week pilot with Lighthouse customer to validate activation flow before broad wave scheduling.
acceptance_criteria: Roadmap backlog with ordered initiatives and owners published to Confluence (link below).
Compatibility sandbox MVP: automated preflight checks + adapter for top 3 customer stack patterns.
Cross-team contracting template approved by Legal and Security and accepted by Sales/CS for pilot customers.
Rollout playbook with canary gating logic, failure budget, and rollback recipe documented.
Telemetry plan defined: activation latency, mean time to onboard, and per-tenant error rate dashboards available in Console.
decisions: Prioritize 'core checks' (network, model-compat, KMS integration) in Q2; adapters follow in Q3 to reduce initial scope.
Use pilot-first approach with one Lighthouse customer to validate runbook and telemetry before full cohort activation.
Adopt a 'sprint buffer' of 20% of Eng capacity for private onboarding tasks during Q2 to absorb unexpected integration work.
